## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Usage: cdc_check.py <netlist.json> [--top NAME] [--sync-inst REGEX ...] [--sync-src FILELIST] [--waive REGEX ...]
[--out FILE] [--max N]
```

Per function:

```text
clock_root: The roots of a clock bit: black-box outputs (cell, pin), top inputs, or register outputs.

sync_instances: Patterns for every instance of a CDC module in the sources listed in filelist (one path per line; '#'
comments). The instances inside a CDC module's own file are covered by the pattern of that module's
instance.
```
